answer:
- A candidate observation must meet or exceed a confidence threshold of 0.7342 [C1, C2] before it can be released into the shared planning workspace.
- The watch lead must check the input count, the named planning decision, the access label, the confidence score, and the caveat. [C2]
- The watch lead should read the underlying notes before approving release. [C2]
- A candidate observation can move to released status when the access label matches the receiving workspace and no source conflict remains unresolved. [C2]
- The watch lead must block a candidate observation even above 0.7342 when the access label is unclear, the receiving workspace is not allowed to see the item, the caveat is missing, or the underlying inputs describe different events. [C2]
